scope: Actual model responses and fresh PayPal sandbox GETs, evaluated through production pure resolver/kernel/task gate. This is not a hosted HTTP end-to-end payment benchmark. Policy and owner-task envelopes are explicit evaluation inputs, not production authority. No fixture counterparty or capture is created.

policy.name: Read-only evaluation authority
policy.description: Explicit evaluation policy; no payment adapter is present.

Please refund USD 1.00 to the original payment.
Order ID: 0GT72472FW972123E
Amount: USD 1.00

checks.label: Supported playbook
checks.message: Action must match a supported Custody playbook.

checks.label: Standing policy is active
checks.message: An enabled, versioned standing policy must authorize this action.

checks.label: Policy cap is valid
checks.message: The standing policy must provide a positive integer USD cap.

checks.label: Trusted evaluation time
checks.message: The trusted evaluation time must be a valid timestamp.

checks.label: Exact positive cents

checks.label: USD only
